name: HungerNet Backend
author: support@hungernet.dev
description: HungerNet FastAPI backend using uv, PostgreSQL, and Redis.
startup: cd /home/container/backend && export PATH="/home/container/.local/bin:$PATH" && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port {{SERVER_PORT}}

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
apt update
apt install -y git curl

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

if [ -d .git ]; then
    git pull
else
    git clone https://github.com/HungerNet/Platform.git .
fi

cd backend

export HOME=/mnt/server

curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"

uv sync

uv run alembic upgrade head

echo "Install complete"
exit 0
